results.title: How Do Higgsfield Plans Work?
results.snippet:
Back

Higgsfield offers two types of plans: individual and business (Team, Scale, and Enterprise). All available plans and their current prices are on the Pricing page. Individual plans are for solo creators and freelancers, business plans are for teams that need a shared workspace and pooled credit

results.title: Is Higgsfield Free? What the Free Plan Includes
results.snippet:
Back

Higgsfield has a free plan, and every new account starts on it at no cost. It opens a limited set of models and runs one generation at a time. It doesn't include monthly credits or Unlimited models, and its generations can carry a visible Higgsfield watermark. A paid plan opens more models and

results.title: Create a Higgsfield account and sign in
results.snippet:
Back

To create a Higgsfield account, go to higgsfield.ai, select Sign up, and continue with Google, Apple, Microsoft, or email. To sign in later, use the same method you signed up with. If you forgot an email password, reset it from the sign-in page.
